data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $2.90 for fiscal 2023, compared with a diluted loss per share of $0.27 for fiscal 2022 (the 2022 figure reflects the 20-for-1 stock split effective June 2022 and a net loss of $2.7 billion driven largely by Rivian-related valuation losses). That is a swing of $3.17 per share, and because the prior-year figure was negative, a conventional percentage change isn't meaningful; measured against the absolute value of the loss it would be roughly 1,170%, but it is better described as a turnaround from loss to profit. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $30.4 billion, versus a net loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022.
